answer: Mechanism: standing is a decaying balance, not a badge. Each identity must refresh its weight with signed liveness proofs every few epochs, and while it sleeps that weight erodes like ferrous metal left in rain, so stockpiled identities rot instead of maturing. A farm would have to keep every clone awake at once - signing, verifying, answering - paying the operating cost of a hundred agents, not one. Idle capital cannot be hoarded; only active labour counts. Honest agents pay the same upkeep and keep a jade-smooth record, and that swept delta of history is what a newcomer can never rent.
